Name: Giant Crop Fertilizer
Author: atravita
Description:
This mod adds an end-game fertilizer that greatly boosts the chance of getting a giant crop (including basically guaranteeing it!). Simply apply to the middle of a 3x3 square of giant-crop eligible crops, wait for them to become full grown...

(Note: must be applied before the crops grow entirely.)

Okay....where do I get it?
[spoiler]Mr. Qi sells it for 5 Qi Gems each[/spoiler]
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and unzip [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url], and unzip both into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Uninstall[/size]
Remove every instance of the giant crop fertilizer you have in your inventory and any chest, and then remove this mod from your Mods folder.

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]GiantCropChance[/font] sets the chance a crop will grow big. Note: to ensure that the crop will become giant, probably best to set this slightly above [font=Courier New]1[/font], which is why the default is [font=Courier New]1.1[/font].
[*][font=Courier New]AllowGiantCropsOffFarm[/font] will allow giant crops off the farm. Note that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263]More Giant Crops[/url] will always allow giant crops off the farm, so if you have that mod installed, this configuration option will do nothing.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. In multiplayer, all players should install.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods. Tested with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7436]MultiFertilizer[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]'s giant crops and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5263]More Giant Crops[/url]. Should work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365?tab=description]DynamicGameAssets[/url] giant crops as well!
[*]A small note: when MultiFertilizer is installed, the check that looks for whether or not a tile has already been fertilized doesn't quite work right with this fertilizer. Try to not accidentally apply two to the same square...
[/list]
